doc_units.fact: If the positioning mode was changed by mistake, it should be set back to the correct setting.

doc_units.fact: The parameter information for Ethernet communication errors includes parameter storage location, parameter type, I/O number, parameter number, and parameter item number.

doc_units.fact: Error code 3073H indicates that the IPv4 gateway address is outside the allowed range, and the recommended action is to consult the local Mitsubishi representative.

doc_units.quote: The robot must be installed to avoid interference with buildings, structures, utilities, other machines and equipment that may create trapping or pinch points.
doc_units.fact: The robot installation must prevent interference with surrounding structures and equipment that could create trapping or pinch points.

doc_units.quote: The communication status between an Ethernet-equipped module and external device can be checked by using Ethernet diagnostics.
doc_units.fact: Ethernet diagnostics lets you check the communication status between an Ethernet-equipped module and an external device.

doc_units.quote: Information collected before the power was turned off or reset can also be displayed. This allows the user to identify the cause of an error based on past operations and error occurrence trends.
doc_units.fact: Event history retains information collected before power-off or reset, helping identify error causes from past operations and trends.

doc_units.quote: The length of the XSYSTEM cable (1.8 m) and the length of the Front Panel extension cable (3 m) should also be considered when choosing an installation location.
doc_units.fact: The XSYSTEM cable is 1.8 m and the Front Panel extension cable is 3 m, which must be considered when choosing the installation location.

doc_units.quote: The brake release button is built-in and integrated into the LED indicator light on the top of the outer link. Pressing this button while the 24 VDC Control Power is ON and High Power is disabled will release the brake.
doc_units.fact: The built-in brake release button on the outer link releases the brake when 24 VDC Control Power is ON and High Power is disabled.

doc_units.quote: Releasing a brake may cause the quill, tool flange, end-effector, and payload to drop. doc_units.fact: Releasing the brake can cause the quill, tool flange, end-effector, and payload to drop, so the equipment must be supported and the end-effector and payload must be clear of obstructions before releasing the brake.

doc_units.quote: If you want to communicate with multiple external devices using the same local port number, use TCP.
doc_units.fact: To communicate with multiple external devices using the same local port number, TCP should be used instead of UDP.

doc_units.quote: It is recommended to use a properly secured, 18 mm (minimum) thick steel plate with a maximum surface roughness of 25 μm as a robot mounting surface.
doc_units.fact: The manual recommends a properly secured steel plate at least 18 mm thick with surface roughness no greater than 25 μm for mounting the robot.

doc_units.quote: 2DAB | System | Error | Moderate | Connection setting parameter own node port number error | Parameter information |  |
doc_units.fact: Event code 2DAB indicates a moderate connection setting parameter error for the own node port number.

doc_units.quote: A SSCNET III cable was disconnected. | Check if "Ab" is displayed in the corresponding axis and following axes. | Replace the SSCNET III cable of the corresponding axis.
doc_units.fact: If a SSCNET III cable is disconnected, "Ab" appears on the affected axis and following axes, and the cable should be replaced.

doc_units.quote: Check if the power supply voltage is 160 V AC or less.
doc_units.fact: The check method for low power supply voltage is to measure whether it is 160 V AC or less.

doc_units.quote: The thermal sensor in the encoder is malfunctioning.
doc_units.fact: A third cause of servo motor overheat alarm is a malfunctioning thermal sensor in the encoder.

doc_units.quote: A home position return did not complete normally with the positioning function.
doc_units.fact: Alarm 90 indicates that a home position return did not complete normally with the positioning function.

doc_units.quote: | 1901H, 1902H | A memory check error has occurred. | • Execute the hardware test. • If the error occurs again even after the above action is taken, the possible cause is a hardware failure of the module on which the error occurred. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative. |
doc_units.fact: Error code 1901H or 1902H indicates a memory check error, and the manual's action is to run the hardware test and then contact Mitsubishi if it persists.

doc_units.quote: When the ground terminal of the module cannot be grounded, the communication line may be closed due to the effects of noise, making it impossible to communicate with other devices.
doc_units.fact: If the module's ground terminal is not grounded, noise can close the communication line and block communication with other devices.

doc_units.quote: Set the execution interval of CPU communication and communication timeout time with sufficient execution interval.
doc_units.fact: The simple CPU communication execution interval and communication timeout time must be set with sufficient margin.

doc_units.quote: Is not the scanning time long for the CPU module where the simple CPU communication function is set?
doc_units.fact: A long scan time in the CPU module running simple CPU communication can prevent communication at the set execution interval.

doc_units.quote: | (2) | The setting of "Command input pulse train filter selection" in [Pr. PA13] is not correct. | Check if the command pulse frequency is within the setting range of the filter. | It is out of setting range. | Correct the filter setting. |
doc_units.fact: Cause (2) of alarm 35.1 is an incorrect setting of Command input pulse train filter selection in [Pr. PA13], and the action is to correct the filter setting if the command pulse frequency is out of the filter setting range.

doc_units.quote: High Power safety timeout must be enabled to allow the indicator to flash after a High Power request is made. The default setting is 10 seconds.
doc_units.fact: The High Power indicator only flashes after a High Power request when the High Power safety timeout is enabled, with a default of 10 seconds.

doc_units.quote: (3) | A ground fault occurred at the servo motor. | Disconnect the servo motor power cables on motor side, and check insulation of the motor (between U/V/W/ ).
doc_units.fact: Cause (3) of alarm 24 is a ground fault in the servo motor, checked by disconnecting the motor-side power cables and measuring insulation between U/V/W.

doc_units.quote: Check that the High Power indicator flashes. After the High Power request is made and the in-dicator is checked, the procedure is complete.
doc_units.fact: The High Power indicator must flash after a High Power request is made, and this completes the check.

doc_units.quote: C815H | Error in remote password. (Authentication failure count is 10.) | Re-execute remote password unlock after the specified time elapses.
doc_units.fact: Error C815H occurs when the remote password authentication failure count has reached 10, and recovery requires waiting the specified time before retrying unlock.

doc_units.quote: The display shows "b##". (Note) | The test operation mode is enabled. | Check the [Pr. PC05] setting. | Cancel the test operation mode. | [B]
doc_units.fact: A "b##" display means the test operation mode is enabled, and it can be cancelled by checking the [Pr. PC05] setting.

doc_units.quote: When the password mismatch count reaches a fixed count (upper limit) in the unlock process of remote password, access is locked out. If this occurs, unauthorized access from outside the system can be considered as a cause of the error.
doc_units.fact: The remote password function locks out access when the number of password mismatches reaches a fixed upper limit, which may indicate unauthorized access.

doc_units.quote: 2DABH | A parameter error in external device configuration was detected. | Check the own node port number setting in External Device Configuration in Ethernet Module Parameter.
doc_units.fact: Error code 2DABH is also an external device configuration parameter error, resolved by checking the own node port number setting in the Ethernet module parameter.

doc_units.quote: Dispose of any battery that has been dropped or otherwise subjected to excessive shock. Batteries that have been subjected to shock may leak if they are used.
doc_units.fact: Any battery that has been dropped or subjected to excessive shock must be disposed of because it may leak if used.

doc_units.quote: When the serial communication error turns ON, the error code and error detail will be stored in the relevant device.
doc_units.fact: When a serial communication error flag turns ON, the corresponding error code and error detail are stored in dedicated devices.

doc_units.quote: CFB0H | Transmission has failed due to retransmission timeout.
doc_units.fact: Error code CFB0H indicates that transmission failed because of a retransmission timeout.

doc_units.quote: Check if the trouble is solved by increasing the auto tuning response ([Pr. PA09]).
doc_units.fact: A checkpoint is to see if increasing the auto tuning response (Pr. PA09) solves the trouble.

doc_units.quote: 7640H | IVMC instruction send data 1: Mode error A parameter was written in a mode other than computer link operation mode or while inverter was operating. | The inverter accepts data corresponding to send data 2. It is not brought to an alarm stop.
doc_units.fact: Error code 7640H indicates a mode error in send data 1, where a parameter was written outside computer link operation mode or while the inverter was running, and the inverter still accepts send data 2 without alarm stopping.

doc_units.quote: The LED indicator does not reflect the robot's High Power status. To see the robot's High Power status, use the Front Panel indicator or a user-supplied indicator connected to the XFP connector.
doc_units.fact: The LED indicator does not reflect the robot's High Power status; the Front Panel indicator or a user-supplied indicator connected to the XFP connector should be used instead.

doc_units.quote: Any change to the robot can lead to loss in safety or functionality. It is the user’s responsibility to perform a risk assessment for the whole (modified) robot after any such changes and to confirm that all safety features of the robot are operational.
doc_units.fact: Any robot change requires the user to perform a full risk assessment and confirm all safety features still work.

doc_units.quote: Robot failure to power ON is indicated by no LED indicators illuminating or faults displaying.
doc_units.fact: A robot that fails to power ON shows no illuminated LED indicators and no displayed faults.

doc_units.quote: If the test fails, check the following and perform the test again.
doc_units.fact: When the PING test fails, the manual instructs to check connection to the Ethernet network, parameter settings written in the CPU module, operating status of the CPU module, IP addresses, and whether the external device has been reset after CPU module replacement.

doc_units.quote: Apply Loctite thread lock type 243 or equivalent.
doc_units.fact: Loctite 243 or equivalent thread lock must be applied to the hardstop screws.

doc_units.quote: For the IP address of the Ethernet module or EtherNet/IP module, the value in the IP address storage area has precedence over the module parameter value.
doc_units.fact: The IP address stored in the IP address storage area overrides the value set in the module parameter.

doc_units.quote: Alarm content | [AL. 50 Overload 1] or [AL. 51 Overload 2] may occur.
doc_units.fact: E1 warning can escalate to alarm AL. 50 Overload 1 or AL. 51 Overload 2.

doc_units.quote: Any High Power push-buttons must be installed outside of the robot's workspace.
doc_units.fact: High Power push-buttons must be installed outside the robot's workspace.

doc_units.quote: Debris can accumulate around robot joints. Take extra effort to clean around these areas.
doc_units.fact: Debris tends to accumulate around the robot joints, so cleaning should focus on those areas.

doc_units.quote: AL. 50 | Analog | Motor speed | Torque | Current command | Droop pulses (100 pulses) | Overload alarm margin | Bus voltage | Effective load ratio | 56.8 | 14563
doc_units.fact: AL. 50 records motor speed, torque, current command, droop pulses (100 pulses), overload alarm margin, bus voltage, and effective load ratio at a 56.8 ms sampling time for 14563 ms.

doc_units.quote: If the reestablishment is time-critical, it is recommended to change the host station port number on the Active open side.
doc_units.fact: When fast re-establishment is needed, changing the host station port number on the active-open side is recommended.

doc_units.quote: You must perform the Lockout and Tagout procedure prior to servicing the robot.
doc_units.fact: Lockout and Tagout must be performed before any servicing of the robot.

doc_units.quote: The communication protocol is failure. | Check if transmission data conforms to the communication protocol. | It is not conforming. | Modify the transmission data according to the communication protocol.
doc_units.fact: If the transmission data does not conform to the communication protocol, the data must be modified according to the protocol.

doc_units.quote: 1921H: Un\G62 (IP address storage area clear error code)
doc_units.fact: Error code 1921H is stored in Un\G62 as the IP address storage area clear error code.

doc_units.quote: | 7E41H | Data length error | The number of points that can be exchanged at the time of random reading/writing are exceeded and specified. | Check the sent message of the counterpart equipment, modify it if necessary, and then execute communication again. |
doc_units.fact: Error 7E41H indicates a data length error with too many points specified for random reading/writing, requiring the sent message to be checked and modified.

doc_units.quote: The number of target IP address setting is outside the range. (IP filter settings)
doc_units.fact: Event code 3095 is raised when the configured number of target IP addresses in the IP filter settings is outside the allowed range.

doc_units.quote: *1. IO Connection Cycle Time controls communication interval independent of the robot controller data refresh rate.
doc_units.fact: The IO Connection Cycle Time sets the communication interval separately from the robot controller's data refresh rate.

doc_units.quote: | (2) | The connection of the servo motor is incorrect. | Check the wiring of U/V/W. | It is incorrect. | Connect it correctly. |
doc_units.fact: The second check for alarm 50.1 is whether the U/V/W wiring of the servo motor is incorrect; if incorrect, connect it correctly.

doc_units.quote: 7608H | Sending timeout error | Sending to the inverter was not completed within the specified time.
doc_units.fact: Error code 7608H indicates a sending timeout error when sending to the inverter was not completed within the specified time.

doc_units.quote: When two or more errors occur at the same time, priority is given to the error code with the smallest number, and the error code with the smallest number is sent. Further, in case of an occurrence of the following errors, initialize the entire transmission sequence.
doc_units.fact: When multiple errors occur simultaneously, the smallest-numbered error code is reported, and for these errors the entire transmission sequence must be initialized.

doc_units.quote: | Login Name | Set the login name to be used for file transfer request (login) from the external device. | 12 characters maximum (one- byte alphanumeric character) (Default: FXCPU) |
doc_units.fact: The FTP server login name parameter accepts a maximum of 12 one-byte alphanumeric characters, with a default value of FXCPU.

doc_units.quote: 21.1 | Encoder data error 1 | (1) | The encoder detected a high speed/acceleration rate due to an oscillation or other factors. | Decrease the loop gain, and then check the repeatability. | It is not repeatable. | Use the encoder with low loop gain. | [A] [B] [C ]
doc_units.fact: For alarm 21.1 encoder data error 1, one cause is a high speed/acceleration rate from oscillation, and the check method is to decrease loop gain and verify repeatability.

doc_units.quote: Remove the servo motor and all the wiring from the machine, and check if the servo motor shaft can be rotated by the hands. (If it is rotated by the hands, the brake has a failure.)
doc_units.fact: The manual instructs disconnecting the servo motor from the machine and checking whether the shaft can be turned by hand to detect brake failure.

doc_units.quote: When the serial communication error turns ON, the error code is stored in the corresponding device specified in the table below.
doc_units.fact: The serial communication error code is stored in the corresponding SD device when the serial communication error flag turns ON.

doc_units.quote: This function can be used only for the FX5CPU which is connected with the external device (including a multi-drop connection station). This function cannot be used for the FX5CPU of another station via the network system.
doc_units.fact: The loopback test is restricted to the directly connected FX5CPU and cannot be used on a remote station over the network.

doc_units.quote: When the clamp is in the desired location, apply thread lock and tighten the socket-head screw to a torque of 4.5 N-m.
doc_units.fact: After positioning the clamp collar, apply thread lock and tighten the socket-head screw to 4.5 N-m.

doc_units.quote: If a controller is detected but resides on a different LAN and does not have a gateway config-ured, an online connection is not possible until one of the following actions are taken.
doc_units.fact: A controller on a different LAN without a configured gateway cannot connect online until its network settings or the PC's network settings are changed.

doc_units.quote: After cam data was written, the cam control command was turned on without cycling the power.
doc_units.fact: The F6.6 cam control inactive warning can be caused by turning on the cam control command after writing cam data without first cycling the power.

doc_units.quote: EM2/EM1 (Forced stop) turned off.
doc_units.fact: The E6 servo forced stop warning is triggered when the EM2/EM1 forced stop signal is turned off.

doc_units.quote: To find a robot controller on the Ethernet network, click the Detect and Configure Robotic Controller Button.
doc_units.fact: The Detect and Configure Robotic Controller Button is used to find a robot controller on the Ethernet network.

doc_units.quote: Batch reading | Bit units | BR | 42H, 52H | Reads data in 1-point units from bit devices. | 256 points
doc_units.fact: The BR command reads bit device data in 1-point units, with a maximum of 256 points per request.

doc_units.quote: 1F00H | A communication error occurred in MELSOFT connection. | • Check the number of connected connections in the whole MELSOFT connection. • Check the number of UDP connections in the MELSOFT connection.
doc_units.fact: Error code 1F00H indicates a communication error in MELSOFT connection, and the manual advises checking the total number of connected connections and the number of UDP connections.

doc_units.quote: 51 | Overload 2 | 51.1 | Thermal overload error 3 during operation | DB | (Note 1) | 0 | 1
doc_units.fact: Alarm 51.1 is a thermal overload error 3 during operation with stop method DB.

doc_units.quote: C05CH Error in request contents. (Reading or writing by bit unit for word device, etc.) Correct request content, and send to Ethernet module again. (Subcommand correction, etc.)
doc_units.fact: Error C05CH indicates a request content error such as reading or writing by bit unit for a word device, and the fix is to correct the request content and resend.

doc_units.quote: Use the engineering tool to check the errors that have occurred and their history, and identify the cause(s) of the errors. This method will yield more detailed information, the cause(s) of the errors, and the actions to eliminate them, compared with checking with LEDs.
doc_units.fact: Using the engineering tool to check error history provides more detailed causes and corrective actions than checking LEDs alone.

doc_units.quote: 7168H | A command that cannot be executed in RUN mode is specified. | STOP the CPU and then execute communication again.
doc_units.fact: Error code 7168H means a command that cannot be executed in RUN mode was sent, requiring the CPU to be stopped before retrying communication.

doc_units.quote: The designated operation IP address is not set correctly.
doc_units.fact: The designated operation IP address is set incorrectly.

doc_units.quote: C051H | Maximum number of bit devices for which data can be read/ written all at once is outside the allowable range. | Correct number of bit devices that can be read or written all at once, and send to Ethernet module again.
doc_units.fact: Error C051H occurs when the number of bit devices requested in one read or write exceeds the allowable maximum, and the count must be corrected.

doc_units.quote: 1861H | The data in the transmitted packet exceeded the size that can be transmitted by one packet. | • Check the settings for the BACnet device of the communication destination. • Confirm the causes of increase in packet size.
doc_units.fact: Error code 1861H indicates that the transmitted packet exceeded the maximum size allowed for a single packet, and the manual advises checking the destination BACnet device settings and investigating why packet size increased.

doc_units.quote: An error occurred in the communication with the internal network module.
doc_units.fact: Alarm 8C indicates a communication error with the servo amplifier's internal network module.

doc_units.quote: F4.9 | Home position return type error warning | (1) | A home position return type was set out of setting range. | Check the setting value ([Pr. doc_units.fact: Alarm F4.9 is a home position return type error warning caused by [Pr. PT45] being set to a value that does not correspond to a valid home position return type.

doc_units.quote: The torque ripple is vibrating.
doc_units.fact: When the torque ripple is vibrating, the recommended action is to adjust the servo gain with auto tuning and set the machine resonance suppression filter.

doc_units.quote: | 1E | Encoder initial communication error 2 | 1E.1 | Encoder malfunction | DB | 1 | 0 |
doc_units.fact: Alarm 1E.1 is an encoder initial communication error 2 caused by encoder malfunction.

doc_units.quote: The temperature sensor on the embedded processor board is at its temperature limit.
doc_units.fact: Error -606 Robot overheated triggers when the embedded processor board's temperature sensor reaches its limit.

doc_units.quote: If more than one error occurs at the same time, the error code detected first is returned.
doc_units.fact: When multiple errors occur simultaneously, only the first-detected error code is reported.

doc_units.quote: While the backup/restore functions of the CPU module are being executed, the file transfer instruction cannot be performed.
doc_units.fact: The file transfer instruction cannot be executed while the CPU module's backup/restore functions are running.

doc_units.quote: Maximum output current flowed continuously due to machine collision or the like.
doc_units.fact: Alarm 51 Overload 2 occurs when maximum output current flows continuously because of a machine collision or similar event.

doc_units.quote: The Teach Pendant jumper plug is provided to allow the system to operate when Teach Pendant cabling is installed, but the Teach Pendant is not connected.
doc_units.fact: The Teach Pendant jumper plug permits operation when the pendant cable is present but the pendant itself is not connected.

doc_units.quote: If a timeout error occurs during file transfer, the TCP/IP connection will be closed. Log into the CPU module with the FTP client again before resuming file transfer.
doc_units.fact: A timeout during file transfer causes the TCP/IP connection to close, and the FTP client must log in again before resuming.

doc_units.quote: The robot must be completely installed with all safety equipment connected and verified.
doc_units.fact: The robot must be fully installed and all safety equipment must be connected and verified before connection.

Match it with the true connection method for the FTP server side (PORT/PASV). If any proxy server exists, inquire the network administrator.
doc_units.fact: The FTP connection method must match the FTP server side PORT or PASV setting, and any proxy server must be checked with the network administrator.

doc_units.quote: C035H | The existence of the external device could not be confirmed within the response monitoring timer value. | • Check the operation of the external device. • Reexamine and change the set values for existence confirmation. • Check whether the connection cable is not disconnected.
doc_units.fact: Error C035H means the external device did not respond within the response monitoring timer, so check the device, existence-confirmation settings, and cable continuity.

doc_units.quote: The close mounting is out of specifications.
doc_units.fact: The overheat warning can also be caused by close mounting that is out of specifications.

doc_units.quote: For the IP address of the Ethernet module or EtherNet/IP module, the value in the IP address storage area has precedence over the module parameter value.
doc_units.fact: The IP address stored in the IP address storage area overrides the value set in the module parameter.

doc_units.quote: Do not specify 5549 to 5569 (15ADH to 15C1H) because these ports are used by the system.
doc_units.fact: Port numbers 5549 to 5569 are reserved for system use and must not be specified.

doc_units.quote: 8E.8 | Modbus RTU communication CRC error | SD |
doc_units.fact: Alarm 8E.8 indicates a Modbus RTU communication CRC error, also with forced stop deceleration (SD).

doc_units.quote: Batteries may leak, rupture, heat, or ignite. Never short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or incinerate a battery or subject it to strong shock.
doc_units.fact: Batteries can leak, rupture, heat, or ignite if short-circuited, charged, disassembled, heated, incinerated, or subjected to strong shock.

doc_units.quote: For a single UDP port, if a new request message is sent while waiting for the response message after sending the first request message, the new request message will be discarded.
doc_units.fact: When using UDP, sending a new request before receiving the response to the first request causes the new request to be discarded.

doc_units.quote: The designated operation IP address is not set correctly.
doc_units.fact: The designated operation IP address is set incorrectly.

doc_units.quote: Refer to 4-4 Enabling and Disabling the Robot on page 4-7 for more in- formation.
doc_units.fact: More information about enabling and disabling the robot is in section 4-4 on page 4-7.

doc_units.quote: F0.3 | Vibration tough drive warning | (1) | The setting value of the machine resonance suppression filter was changed due to a machine resonance. | Check if it was changed frequently. | It was changed frequently. | Set the machine resonance suppression filter. Check the machine status for screw looseness or others.
doc_units.fact: The F0.3 vibration tough drive warning occurs when machine resonance repeatedly changes the machine resonance suppression filter setting, and the remedy is to set that filter and inspect the machine for screw looseness.

doc_units.quote: Error flags The operation error flag turns ON when an operation error occurs in the inverter communication instruction. Verify that the device specified in the table below is ON.
doc_units.fact: The operation error flag turns ON when an operation error occurs in the inverter communication instruction, and the specified device must be checked.

doc_units.quote: Alarm No.: 9B | Name: Error excessive warning | Alarm content | Droop pulses have exceeded the warning occurrence level.
doc_units.fact: Alarm 9B is an error excessive warning triggered when droop pulses exceed the warning occurrence level.

doc_units.quote: The torque limit has been enabled. | Check if the limiting torque is in progress. | The limiting torque is in progress. | Increase the torque limit value.
doc_units.fact: If the torque limit is active, increase the torque limit value.

doc_units.quote: Error codes are stored in built-in Ethernet error code SD10130 (connection 1) to SD10137 (connection 8).
doc_units.fact: Ethernet communication error codes are stored in special registers SD10130 through SD10137 for connections 1 to 8.

doc_units.quote: The LED indicator does not reflect the robot's High Power status. To see the robot's High Power status, use the Front Panel indicator or a user-supplied indicator connected to the XFP connector.
doc_units.fact: The LED indicator does not reflect the robot's High Power status; the Front Panel indicator or a user-supplied indicator connected to the XFP connector should be used instead.

doc_units.quote: C051H | Maximum number of bit devices for which data can be read/ written all at once is outside the allowable range. | Correct number of bit devices that can be read or written all at once, and send to Ethernet module again.
doc_units.fact: Error C051H occurs when the number of bit devices requested in one read or write exceeds the allowable maximum, and the count must be corrected.

doc_units.quote: After installing the robot, you must test it before you use it for the first time. Failure to do this could cause death, serious injury, or equipment damage.
doc_units.fact: A first-time test is mandatory after installation to avoid death, serious injury, or equipment damage.

doc_units.fact: If the Ethernet module ERROR LED turns on at CPU power-up, it indicates either an Ethernet parameter setting error correctable in GX Works3 or a hardware error requiring repair.

doc_units.quote: A software limit set with the parameter was reached for the positioning function.
doc_units.fact: Alarm 98 indicates that a parameter‑set software limit was reached during positioning.

doc_units.quote: Power is not supplied to OPC (power input for open- collector sink interface). | Between DICOM and OPC of the CN1 connector of the servo amplifier is not connected. | Connect between DICOM and OPC.
doc_units.fact: If power is not supplied to OPC because DICOM and OPC of the CN1 connector are not connected, they must be connected.

doc_units.fact: For the listed severe alarms, repeatedly clearing the alarm and restarting can damage the servo amplifier and servo motor.

doc_units.quote: | Latest Error Code | Displays the error code that indicates the definition of latest error occurred. |
doc_units.fact: The Ethernet diagnostics window displays the latest error code for each connection, which defines the most recent error that occurred.

doc_units.fact: Pins 6 and 14 are the High Power ON/OFF input, normally wired to a momentary push-button that enables High Power only when all safety circuits are satisfied.

doc_units.quote: Are not parameters rewritten during simple CPU communication? | • Check the error code shown in the simple CPU communication status, and take action. • Turn off and on or reset the CPU module power.

doc_units.quote: The close mounting is out of specifications.
doc_units.fact: The overheat warning can also be caused by close mounting that is out of specifications.

doc_units.quote: Set the execution interval of CPU communication and communication timeout time with sufficient execution interval.
doc_units.fact: The simple CPU communication execution interval and communication timeout time must be set with sufficient margin.

doc_units.quote: Only one external device (FTP client) can log into the CPU module at one time. If a connection is attempted from another FTP client in the login state, an error will occur without establishing the connection.
doc_units.fact: The CPU module allows only one FTP client login at a time; a second client attempting to log in while another is connected will get an error and no connection.

doc_units.quote: | 1, 9 | Pendant E-stop button channel 1 | Connected to the pendant's integrated E-stop button. |
doc_units.fact: Pins 1 and 9 carry pendant E-stop button channel 1, which is connected to the pendant's integrated E-stop button.

doc_units.quote: The robot must be installed to avoid interference with buildings, structures, utilities, other machines and equipment that may create trapping or pinch points.
doc_units.fact: The robot installation must prevent interference with surrounding structures and equipment that could create trapping or pinch points.

doc_units.quote: Only replace items on the robot system with the parts supplied by OMRON.
doc_units.fact: Only OMRON-supplied parts should be used for replacement on the robot system.

doc_units.fact: The F0.3 vibration tough drive warning occurs when machine resonance repeatedly changes the machine resonance suppression filter setting, and the remedy is to set that filter and inspect the machine for screw looseness.

doc_units.quote: Robot motion is not possible until High Power is supplied and has been enabled.
doc_units.fact: The robot cannot move until High Power is supplied and enabled.

doc_units.quote: C1B3H | The specified channel is being used by another send/receive instruction. | • Change the channel number. • Execute after the send/receive instruction is completed.
doc_units.fact: Error C1B3H occurs when the specified channel is already in use by another send/receive instruction, and the remedy is to change the channel number or wait until the other instruction completes.

doc_units.quote: 3073H | The gateway address (IPv4) is outside the range. | Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.
doc_units.fact: Error code 3073H indicates that the IPv4 gateway address is outside the allowed range, and the recommended action is to consult the local Mitsubishi representative.

doc_units.quote: If another communication function (MELSOFT connection or SLMP) is simultaneously executed with UDP/IP during file transfer with FTP, an error such as timeout may occur.
doc_units.fact: Simultaneous use of another communication function (MELSOFT connection or SLMP) with UDP/IP during FTP file transfer can cause a timeout error.

doc_units.quote: Manual mode is typically used during functions of commissioning, position teaching, and other setup operations.
doc_units.fact: Manual mode is intended for setup tasks such as commissioning and position teaching.

doc_units.quote: A home position return speed did not decelerate to a creep speed.
doc_units.fact: Detail 90.2 lists the cause that the home position return speed did not decelerate to a creep speed.

doc_units.fact: Alarm 30.1 can be caused by an incorrect regenerative resistor setting, which is verified by checking the regenerative option and Pr. PA02.

doc_units.quote: Residual voltage may be present, wait 2 minutes before servicing.
doc_units.fact: Residual voltage may be present, so servicing requires waiting 2 minutes after lockout and tagout.

doc_units.quote: Do not connect user-supplied Manual / Automatic contacts or other control signals in parallel with the Front Panel switch contact. This would violate the Single Point of Control principle and might allow Automatic mode to be selected while an operator is in the cell.
doc_units.fact: Parallel wiring of user-supplied Manual/Automatic contacts with the Front Panel switch contact violates the Single Point of Control principle and can allow Automatic mode to be selected while an operator is in the cell.

doc_units.quote: Voltage must be maintained during the encoder backup battery replacement procedure to preserve joint position data.
doc_units.fact: Maintaining voltage during battery replacement is necessary to prevent loss of joint position data.

doc_units.quote:

Interface Panel.
doc_units.fact: The 24 VDC Control Power connector must be verified as properly fastened to the robot on the Primary Interface Panel.

doc_units.quote: If the LEDs are not flashing, check the wiring and the communication settings or the master station or other local station setting.
doc_units.fact: If the LEDs are not flashing, the wiring and communication settings of the master or local station should be checked.

doc_units.quote: 7010H | Parity error, overrun error or framing error | Check the wiring.
doc_units.fact: Error code 7010H indicates a parity, overrun, or framing error and the recommended action is to check the wiring.

doc_units.fact: Heavy Ethernet load during simple CPU communication can prevent UDP data reception from completing when other communication such as MELSOFT connection, SLMP communication, or MODBUS/TCP communication runs simultaneously, causing a timeout error.

doc_units.quote: To comply with ISO 10218-1 when using a remote brake release button, ensure the brake release button displays a warning label to indicate that the z-axis of the robot may fall due to gravity if the brake is released.
doc_units.fact: When using a remote brake release button, a warning label must be displayed to indicate that the z-axis may fall due to gravity if the brake is released.

doc_units.quote: Only use the recommended grease on the joint 3 quill. Use THK AFF Grease (part number 20950-000).
doc_units.fact: Only THK AFF Grease, part number 20950-000, is allowed on the Joint 3 quill.

doc_units.quote: The communication status between an Ethernet-equipped module and external device can be checked by using Ethernet diagnostics.
doc_units.fact: Ethernet diagnostics lets you check the communication status between an Ethernet-equipped module and an external device.

doc_units.quote: After changing the positioning mode, initialize the point table method/ program method.
doc_units.fact: After changing the positioning mode, the point table method or program method must be initialized.

doc_units.quote: The number of target IP address setting is outside the range. (IP filter settings)
doc_units.fact: Event code 3095 is raised when the configured number of target IP addresses in the IP filter settings is outside the allowed range.

doc_units.quote: 1F00H | A communication error occurred in MELSOFT connection. | • Check the number of connected connections in the whole MELSOFT connection. • Check the number of UDP connections in the MELSOFT connection.
doc_units.fact: Error code 1F00H indicates a communication error in MELSOFT connection, and the manual advises checking the total number of connected connections and the number of UDP connections.

doc_units.quote: When connecting the CPU module to a LAN line, do not set direct connection. Doing so will apply a load on the LAN line and adversely affect communications with other external devices.
doc_units.fact: Direct connection must not be used when the CPU module is connected to a LAN line, because it would load the LAN line and disrupt other external device communications.

doc_units.quote: C05BH Ethernet module cannot read or write data from/to specified device. Reconsider device to read or write.
doc_units.fact: Error C05BH occurs when the Ethernet module cannot read or write the specified device, and the remedy is to reconsider the device to read or write.

doc_units.quote: 1920H | Values such as the IP address setting (SD8492 to SD8497) are outside the set range. | Recheck the values such as the IP address setting (SD8492 to SD8497).
doc_units.fact: Error code 1920H indicates that IP address settings in SD8492 to SD8497 are outside the valid range, and the corrective action is to recheck those values.

doc_units.quote: If the emergency stop circuit is not operating as expected, the following supplied jumper plugs can be used to troubleshoot the problem.
doc_units.fact: Supplied jumper plugs can be used to troubleshoot an emergency stop circuit that is not operating as expected.

doc_units.fact: If the servo motor power cable is disconnected, repair or replace it.

doc_units.fact: If communication retries are occurring, the manual advises checking the Ethernet line status, including cables, hubs, and routers, for a busy line.

doc_units.quote: To prevent this, a failed indicator causes an error (-924) *Front panel HIGH POWER lamp failure* and locks out the High Power enabling until you replace the indicator.
doc_units.fact: A failed indicator triggers error -924 and prevents High Power from being enabled until the indicator is replaced.

doc_units.quote: When the robot is placed in Manual mode, robot motion speed is limited to 250 mm/sec and servo torque is limited so an operator can safely work inside the cell.
doc_units.fact: In Manual mode, robot speed is capped at 250 mm/sec and servo torque is limited for safe operator access.

doc_units.fact: If the position loop gain is small and the issue is not repeatable, the manual instructs increasing the position loop gain parameter Pr. PB08.

doc_units.fact: Warning E1 with detail E1.1 indicates a thermal overload warning 1 occurring during operation.

doc_units.fact: Alarm 20.1 indicates an encoder normal communication receive data error 1, with stop method EDB.

doc_units.fact: When a noise is reported, the servo motor should be isolated from the load and its power cable disconnected to release the brake so the shaft can be rotated by hand to check for noise.

doc_units.fact: Error -1201 indicates that the fieldbus connection was lost.

doc_units.fact: Incorrect settings of the speed command, speed limit, or electronic gear cause the servo motor speed to not accelerate or to accelerate too much.

doc_units.fact: Writing a large file to the SD memory card in RUN state may cause a communication error, so the CPU module should be set to STOP for such writes.

doc_units.fact: The servo motor rotation accuracy is low and the rotation speed is unstable.

doc_units.fact: Alarm 69 occurs when the command position exceeds 30 bits from the detected position after LSP or LSN is triggered.

doc_units.fact: If multiple errors occur simultaneously, the first error is reported first, and subsequent error codes are sent in the order they occurred.

doc_units.fact: Switch positions on the Primary Interface Panel are reserved for future use and have no impact on robot functionality.

doc_units.fact: Error code C431H indicates the Ethernet connection was closed while the SP.ECPRTCL instruction was running, and the recommended actions are to check the external device, verify connection open status, and reopen the connection before retrying.
